name: coach-note-required-with-quest-event
description: C2: coach_note is day-keyed now, available on every ordinary turn, not just a closing one. A turn that also reports a real quest completion (quest_event) is exactly the case the enforcement rule targets - something happened, so coach_note is required alongside it, not left to Gemini's free choice. K1 testing pass (2026-09-04) live finding: same shape as #10/#12's own precedent - a live run fired quest_event with no coach_note. quest_event is in coachTurn.ts's ACTIONS_REQUIRING_COACH_NOTE, so a real production turn shaped like this gets caught and corrected by the C2 reprompt (coachTurn-reprompt.test.ts covers this deterministically, mocked). This harness calls askGemini() directly, single-shot, and never exercises that reprompt - the actual guarantee to the athlete lives in coachTurn.ts, not in Gemini's first-try compliance. Loosened to match #10/#12 rather than reproduce #670's baseline noise on a case production already self-heals.
